WELCOME TO YOUR UNIVERSE

A few ways to play.

Pick a universe, choose a tool, and experiment. The particles react to gravity and to you.

AttractPress and hold to pull particles toward you.

1

RepelPress and hold to push particles away.

2

LaunchDrag back, then release to fire a cluster in the opposite direction.

3

ConnectTap to place stars and draw your own constellation.

4
Keyboard controls

Focus the universe with Tab. Arrow keys move your aim. Enter toggles a gravity tool, launches a cluster, or places a star. Space pauses, R resets, and H opens this guide. Escape releases a gravity tool.

This is a playful gravity model, not an astronomy simulator. Sound is optional. Reduced-motion preferences start the universe paused.
